# to

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:to`](gmeow-to.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/to>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A primary recipient address of a message (RFC 5322 To).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EmailMessage`](../classes/gmeow-EmailMessage.md) -> [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](../classes/gmeow-EmailAddress.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:to`](gmeow-to.md) from [`gmeow:EmailMessage`](../classes/gmeow-EmailMessage.md) to [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](../classes/gmeow-EmailAddress.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Example Snippets

### Message Thread

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/email/examples/message-thread.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/email/examples/message-thread.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-email-examples-message-thread)#example-slices-extensions-email-examples-message-thread

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: an email message and its reply . A gmeow:EmailMessage
# carries the RFC 5322 envelope as first-class edges to gmeow:EmailAddresses —
# gmeow:from, gmeow:to, gmeow:cc — plus a gmeow:subject. Threading is a relation
# between messages, not a flat field: a reply points at what it answers with
# gmeow:inReplyTo, so the conversation graph is reconstructable from the messages
# themselves. The EmailAddresses are the reified gmeow:ContactPoints of the
# contacts slice — the same objects a person reaches mail through.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/email/> .

# --- The original message: Alice → Bob, cc Carol.
ex:msg1 a gmeow:EmailMessage ;
    gmeow:from    ex:aliceAddr ;
    gmeow:to      ex:bobAddr ;
    gmeow:cc      ex:carolAddr ;
    gmeow:subject "Ontology review draft" .
```
